# SoftwareDefinedInterconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reconfigurable interconnect layer that allows dynamic routing and topology changes between chiplets on a wafer-scale substrate. It provides the flexibility needed for TCC to adapt communication patterns to application demands, enabling efficient topology-centric computation.
